resources.string: Read relative microphone RMS and peak levels in dBFS.
Another audio tool is using the microphone. Stop it and try again.
Microphone capture failed or stopped delivering samples. Try again.
Permission request finished. If granted, tap Start again to begin.
Digital silence: all samples in this window are zero.

dBFS measures digital signal level, not calibrated sound pressure (dB SPL). Microphone gain and device processing affect readings. Do not use this for hearing safety, legal compliance, or calibrated noise measurements.
Capture runs only while this screen is active. Leaving stops it; returning does not restart it. Audio buffers are transient and cleared; no recordings, history, files, or network transmission.
Tap Start, grant microphone permission if requested, then tap Start again. RMS and peak levels use short PCM windows. Stop or leave the screen to end capture.
Digital silence shows −∞ dBFS. A larger digital signal moves closer to 0 dBFS.
Relative dBFS only, not calibrated SPL. Device processing affects readings. No safety or health assessment.
